_source: generated by `python -m mccontrol.webexport` from mccontrol/envelope.py, mccontrol/token.py, mccontrol/mesh.py, mccontrol/mcc3.py; do not edit

_mesh_layout.request: subtype(1) | counter(4 LE) | expiry(4 LE) | raw Ed25519 signature(64) | command UTF-8; the companion prepends its 4-byte tag
_mesh_layout.response: after the tag: node clock(4 LE, unset below clock_set_from) | counter(4 LE) | code(1) | reply UTF-8, possibly cut inside a character (drop the partial one)
_mesh_layout.topic: meshcore/{REGION upper}/{whole key upper}/cmd, or meshcore/mesh/{key}/cmd on a mesh-only node

_mcc3_store_layout.announce: the first byte of the node's key, the node's key (1..32), kind 0x4D (33), owner tag (34..37), boot (38..41, u32 LE), sequence (42..45), 47 bytes sealed with K_malive (ChaCha20-Poly1305, nonce 00 x 4 then boot then sequence, AAD bytes 1..45), the first 8 bytes of the tag (93..100), then the node's Ed25519 signature over signature_label and bytes 1..100 (101..164)
_mcc3_store_layout.K_malive: HKDF-SHA256(X25519(owner, announced node), salt empty, info announce.hkdf_info with <KEY> the announced node's key as 64 upper-case hex)
_mcc3_store_layout.owner_tag: SHA-256(owner_tag_label, command key, node key, boot, sequence), first 4 bytes
_mcc3_store_layout.sealed: uptime (u32 LE), clock (u32, 0 while unset), last command counter (u32), flags (u8, the alive message's), battery in millivolts (u16, 0: unknown), version (length byte, at most max_version), name (length byte, at most max_name, cut), zeros to 47
_mcc3_store_layout.seen: base64url without padding of: kind 0x53, the announce's bytes 1..164, SNR (i8, quarter dB), hops (u8), via (u8); published once, not retained, by the Observer on its own key's topic
_mcc3_store_layout.node: base64url without padding of: kind 0x4E, the announce's bytes 1..164, count (u8), then count x (Observer key 32, arrival u32 LE by the server's clock, SNR i8, hops u8, via u8, list u8); retained; each list holds the first catchers_a_list Observers to report that announce
_mcc3_store_layout.state: zero_hop.state, the named Observer's key's first 2 bytes (00 00: none), the announce's bytes 1..164; a PAYLOAD_TYPE_CONTROL packet with no path, never forwarded
_mcc3_store_layout.ack: zero_hop.ack, the node's key's first 4 bytes, the report id (the signature's first 4 bytes), the Observer's whole key (32); unsigned
_mcc3_store_layout.direct_report: an ANON_REQ sent direct along a path: the 165-byte announce, the Observer it is for (its key's first 2 bytes), the path length (u8), the path from the node to that Observer; the trailer is outside the signature
_mcc3_store_layout.path_ack: an ANON_REQ sent direct along the reversed path: the node's key's first byte, the Observer's key (32), kind 0x4B, the report id (4), the path length (u8), the path from the node to the Observer in a 16-byte field, zero after it
_mcc3_store_layout.guest_key: an Ed25519 key pair whose seed is HKDF-SHA256(command seed, salt empty, info guest_key_info): derived again each time, never stored, never shown, not linkable to the command key
_mcc3_store_layout.guest_forward: base64url without padding of: kind 0x47 (G), the guest key (32), nonce (12), then the fields of a forward from its counter on, sealed with K_gfwd (ChaCha20-Poly1305, AAD the first 45 bytes); the result is a forward result (kind 0x66) sealed with K_gfwd
_mcc3_store_layout.K_gfwd: HKDF-SHA256(X25519(guest key, relay), salt empty, info guest_forward.hkdf_info with <KEY> the relay's key as 64 upper-case hex)
_mcc3_store_layout.reading: for each retained mcc/node/<KEY>: the owner tag with your own command key (one SHA-256), then the node's signature, then the seal; one that fails is skipped silently; remember each (node key, boot, sequence) tried
